name: Juice Adventure
notes: 5 photos: 1-2 are an older physical wall board, 3-5 are the current digital TV menu (3 wide, 4-5 zoomed and clearest). Same items appear on both with different prices; used the clearer, presumably current digital-menu prices and noted the older board only here. Prices shown are the 16oz/base size where a drink comes in 16oz/24oz/32oz tiers. This is a juice/smoothie bar, so smoothies and juices are the core menu (not treated as a skippable drink-only list); no beer/wine/cocktail items were present to skip.
